QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] Antares Lost
QuestInfo.1: The darkness has not yet reached Oort. You should devise a countermeasure before it is completely engulfed.
QuestInfo.0: First, you decided to send the constellations down to a place of greater safety. But then #o9402188# dashed off somewhere, and when you chased after it, you encountered #o9602459#. For now, you should defeat #o9602459#.
QuestInfo.2: After defeating #o9602459# and finding #p9402188#, the stars lost their way and scattered across Maple World. Search for the traces of the stars that fell to the ground.
